svg.title: Four-gated palace of the peaceful and wrathful mandala
svg.desc: A drawn study of the supplied painting: coloured fire, a vajra enclosure, blue water and wind bands, charnel grounds, lotus enclosures and the four-gated palace with gold vajras at its corners. Low reclining deer flank an eight-spoked Dharma wheel beneath a small canopy at each gate. Wide saffron parasols flank the upper and lower gates, while tiered victory banners and orange streamers flank the side gates.
